name: ESF Summer Camps at Montgomery School
description_short: ESF day camp on the Montgomery School campus in Chester Springs for boys and girls from rising preschool to grade 10. Campers are grouped by grade, swim with Red Cross certified lifeguards and instructors, and pick from more than 60 activities across sports, arts, science, engineering and technology.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel by March 15, 2027 for a refund less the $50 registration fee (a full cancellation also costs $300 per child); from March 16 to June 1, 2027, a credit instead of a refund; no refunds or credits after June 1. An optional protection plan covers injury or illness.
notes: Standard 2027 rates for the main day camp (rising PreS to 8th): 2 weeks $1,290 up to 9 weeks $5,535; early bird until February 1, 2027 is $1,190 for 2 weeks. 5+ weeks save $30 a week. The page still shows 2026 rates for the Young Leaders Program (rising 9 and 10), so those are left out. Weeks need not be consecutive. Standard hours 9:00 to 3:00. Club OT extended day until 5:00 is included in tuition; 5:00 to 5:30 costs extra. Optional lunch program at extra cost. Address given as 1141 Kimberton Road (Route 113). No camp Monday July 5, 2027.
